description_en: Calls GenerateSysAppDownloadInfo to obtain download information for IoVCC system applications
description_zh: 调用GenerateSysAppDownloadInfo获取IoVCC系统应用下载信息
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc generate-sys-app-download-info --plugins PkgName_:_com.aliyun.aicc.yundevice_,_VersionCode_:20180228_,_PkgName_:_com.aliyun.aicc.remoteassistant_,_VersionCode_: --sign-mode customized --os-type 1 --pkg-name com.aliyun.aicc --project-id 11 --cert-file-object-key 1768723179523459/11/2018-05-07/1525699039841.rsa --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateSysAppDownloadInfo

parameters.help_en: The collection of plugins selected by the user when downloading the AiCC Container application. Multiple selections are supported. The value is stored as a JSON array
parameters.help_zh: 下载AiCC Container应用时，用户选择的插件集合，支持多选，以json数组存储
parameters.name: plugins

parameters.help_en:
The signing method. Valid values:

- **customized**: custom signing
- **platform**: platform signing
parameters.help_zh:
签名方式。取值：

- **customized**：自定义签名
- **platform**：由平台签名
parameters.name: sign_mode

parameters.help_en: The operating system type. Set this parameter to 1 for Android
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en: The package name of the system application that the user selects to download
parameters.help_zh: 用户选择下载的系统应用包名
parameters.name: pkg_name

parameters.help_en: The full file name of the RSA certificate file in OSS after it is uploaded to OSS
parameters.help_zh: RSA证书文件上传OSS后，在OSS上的完整文件名
parameters.name: cert_file_object_key
